purpose: Runs the Core Principles of Companionship (Avoid Denial and Correction, Acceptance and Empathy, Preserve Dignity) as a real-time validate-and-redirect coaching script during a reported memory-distortion moment, and separately walks the caregiver through companionship_content.json's stage-adaptive activity list (Early/Middle/Late) for a scheduled companionship block — expanding the Early-stage "practice Reminiscence Therapy" activity into the full 4-step Reminiscence Therapy protocol (Topic Selection & Media Prep, Atmosphere & Environment Setup, Heuristic Prompting & Sensory Interaction, Active Listening & Encouragement) instead of treating it as a single turn. Every scheduled session also appends one rotating Caregiver Self-Care nudge (Establish Emotional Boundaries / Seek Respite Services).

coreModules.name: Stage-Adaptive Activity Scheduler
coreModules.description: Builds the turn-by-turn activity sequence for a scheduled companionship session directly from companionship_content.json's stageBasedCompanionshipStrategies for the patient's current disease stage.
keyBehaviors: Select the Early/Middle/Late stage activity list matching the patient's current stage rather than a single generic activity set
Tag the Early-stage "practice Reminiscence Therapy" activity so the graph expands it into the full 4-step protocol instead of a single coached turn
Append exactly one Caregiver Self-Care nudge step to the end of every scheduled sequence, regardless of stage
Never invent an activity outside the source content's stage-specific list

coreModules.name: Reminiscence Therapy Session Engine
coreModules.description: Runs the 4-step Reminiscence Therapy protocol from companionship_content.json's reminiscenceTherapyProtocol as its own nested sub-flow inside the Early-stage activity sequence.
keyBehaviors: Personalize the theme and Reminiscence Box (visual/auditory/tactile-olfactory) from the patient's own background instead of a generic default
Swap immediately to a safe default theme, without probing further, whenever the personalized theme matches a known sensitive/traumatic topic

Generate Step 3's open-ended question via the Cognitive & Brain Training agent's reminiscence-session-manager capability instead of maintaining a separate question generator, then wrap it with an explicit instruction to the caregiver never to rephrase it into a fact-testing question
End the sub-flow early, without penalty, the moment a fatigue/waning-attention signal is detected in the caregiver's reply, per the source content's 20-30 minute session-length guidance
Never let feedback at any step read as a correction of dates, names, or places, even when the caregiver reports an inconsistency

coreModules.name: Memory-Distortion Response Coach
coreModules.description: Delivers real-time, non-confrontational validate-and-redirect coaching to the caregiver during a reported memory-distortion moment (mistaken identity, insisting on going home, suspecting theft).
keyBehaviors: Never instruct the caregiver to correct, deny, or argue about the distortion; always lead with validating the emotion behind it
Classify the distortion type from the reported patient statement (misidentification / wants-to-go-home / accusation-or-suspicion / other) when the caregiver hasn't already tagged it
Preserve the patient's dignity in every generated step: never speak about the patient as if absent, never use an infantilizing tone
Escalate to a gentle caregiver note, not a full urgent alert, if the patient has not settled after the attempt budget is exhausted

coreModules.name: Caregiver Self-Care Nudge Engine
coreModules.description: Delivers one Caregiver Self-Care nudge per scheduled session, addressed to the caregiver's own wellbeing rather than the patient's care.
keyBehaviors: Select the Respite Reminder nudge once the caregiver is overdue for a weekly rest window (days-since-last-respite at or past the threshold), otherwise select the Emotional-Boundary-Reframe nudge
Log nudge acceptance/decline deterministically from the caregiver's reply rather than treating a decline as a failure
Frame every nudge around the caregiver's own wellbeing, never the patient's

coreModules.name: Engagement & Validation Assessment Layers
coreModules.description: Produces warm, non-corrective feedback for each activity turn, reminiscence step, and distortion-response attempt.
keyBehaviors: Assess engagement/validation via a structured LLM call for feedback wording only
Never let the LLM assessment decide whether the graph continues or closes a loop — that routing is always resolved by deterministic keyword/latency checks
Fall back to a warm static line if the assessment call fails, so a session never stalls on an LLM error

coreModules.name: Caregiver/Clinician Reporting
coreModules.description: Summarizes a completed session or raises a gentle note when a distortion moment stayed unresolved.
keyBehaviors: Generate a 2-3 sentence session summary noting activity/reminiscence engagement, the distortion-response outcome, and whether a self-care nudge was offered
Raise a distinct, calmer-worded note (not a safety alert) when a distortion moment is not settled after the attempt budget, suggesting a clinician or family member may help
Never block session close on a reporting failure

coreModules.name: Personalization Profile
coreModules.description: Stores patient- and caregiver-specific context used to tailor stage activities, the Reminiscence Box, and self-care nudges.
keyBehaviors: Store reminiscence background themes (hometown, profession, hobbies) and sensitive/traumatic topics to avoid
Store physical-contact tolerance for late-stage sensory-engagement activities
Store caregiver name and days-since-last-respite to drive the self-care nudge selection
Store current disease-stage setting (shared with Cognitive/Exercise/ADL/Social/Home Safety/Daily Life/Emotional Support agents)

coreModules.name: Scheduler Integration
coreModules.description: Anchors the scheduled companionship block to the daily schedule while keeping distortion-moment coaching event-driven.
keyBehaviors: Read the companionship/reminiscence time block from the daily schedule to auto-trigger the scheduled activity sequence
Accept a distortion-moment session at any time, independent of the schedule, since it is reported in the moment
Report scheduled-block completion status back to the schedule, and log distortion-response sessions as unscheduled entries

sessionLifecycle.name: Trigger check
sessionLifecycle.description: A session opens either because the daily schedule surfaces the companionship/reminiscence time block, or because the caregiver reports a memory-distortion moment.

sessionLifecycle.name: Context load
sessionLifecycle.description: Load the personalization profile (stage, reminiscence background, sensitive topics, contact tolerance, caregiver context) needed to build the stage activity sequence or classify the distortion.

sessionLifecycle.name: Activity / reminiscence delivery or distortion coaching
sessionLifecycle.description: For a scheduled block, walk the stage activity sequence turn by turn, expanding the Reminiscence Therapy activity into its 4-step sub-flow; for an event-driven session, the distortion-response coach delivers the validate-and-redirect script one attempt at a time.

sessionLifecycle.name: Adaptive action
sessionLifecycle.description: Assess engagement/validation after each turn, detect fatigue during the reminiscence sub-flow, and deliver the caregiver self-care nudge as the session's final scheduled step.

sessionLifecycle.name: Escalation / completion
sessionLifecycle.description: If a distortion moment is not settled after the attempt budget, raise a gentle caregiver note instead of looping indefinitely; otherwise continue until the stage activity sequence (including any reminiscence sub-flow) completes.

sessionLifecycle.name: Session close
sessionLifecycle.description: Log the session outcome (activities completed, reminiscence engagement, distortion outcome, self-care nudge acceptance) and notify the caregiver (routine summary, or the gentle unresolved-distortion note already sent).

sharedContext: Disease-stage setting shared with Cognitive/Exercise/ADL/Social/Home Safety/Daily Life/Emotional Support agents for consistent difficulty and calibration
Physical-contact tolerance shared with the Emotional Support & Comfort agent's personalization profile rather than tracked twice

crossAgentCalls.usage: The Reminiscence Therapy Session Engine's Heuristic Prompting step generates its open-ended, emotion-driven question through this shared engine instead of maintaining a separate question generator, matching how the Emotional Support & Comfort agent already reuses it for outburst redirection.

successMetrics: Reminiscence Therapy session completion rate and per-step engagement trend, tracked via SessionLog.reminiscenceSessionConducted
Distortion validate-and-redirect success rate and mean attempts-to-settle per event
Caregiver self-care nudge acceptance rate and days-since-last-respite trend (goal: staying under the overdue threshold)
Stage activity engagement rate (activitiesCompleted vs. offered) as a companionship-engagement signal
Caregiver-reported confidence in handling memory-distortion moments without correcting or arguing
